text:
samantha (support): Hey team — urgent request from Sales: BigFin demo tomorrow 10am PT. Need a short-lived quota bump for one API key, otherwise the demo's synthetic load will hit 429s. Can we do a quick override?

jordan (sales): Confirmed. We'll run a 30–45m stress run and a live demo with ~5 concurrent seats. Estimate peak ~100–120 rps for ~45m.

samantha (support): org_id=98765, api_key=rk_live_ABC123 — customer will use the key directly. Need a path for support to request and get the override applied quickly. :pray:

andy (eng-platform): Quick question — do we want a per-key allowlist (recommended) or a temporary per-org global bump? Per-key is safer. Also need audit reason + TTL.

maria (eng-sre): Agree per-key allowlist. We should also attach a monitoring guard (error rate / latency) and auto-expire.

rashmi (security): Security OK for demo provided we record the audit entry, set a clear TTL, and ensure no long-term data export. No blanket org exceptions without approval.

quota-bot: Automated check: current limits for org 98765 -> per-key 60 rps, per-org burst cap 200 rps, no active overrides.

andy (eng-platform): Procedure (manual admin API) — paste when you file the support ticket so we have a reproducible playbook:
```\n# create a short-lived allowlist override for a single key
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/admin/overrides \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"org_id":"98765","api_key":"rk_live_ABC123","type":"allowlist","limit":150,"ttl_secs":2700,"reason":"Sales demo BigFin 2026-04-01"}'\n```

andy (eng-platform): I'll apply as soon as we have the ticket and Rashmi's acknowledgement in the audit note. I'll also make a temporary dashboard for this key.

samantha (support): Ticket created: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/3219 — please add override id to the ticket. Jordan, can you add the Sales contact to the ticket?

jordan (sales): Added. Contact is emily@bigfin.com.

quota-bot: Override created -> id=ovr_2026_179555, limit=150 rps, expires_in=2700s, audit_url=https://console.redwood.ai/audit/ovr_2026_179555

maria (eng-sre): Added alert: "bigfin-demo-ovr-errors" -> triggers if 5xx% > 2% for 5m. Dashboards: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/alerts/1234

andy (eng-platform): Also FYI for the playbook: prefer allowlist with exact api_key match. If support needs a generic temporary key, we create an ephemeral key bound to the org and apply allowlist to that instead.

samantha (support): Good note, will use ephemeral key next time to avoid leaking customer keys.

jordan (sales): Demo happened, load test + live session. Customer saw no 429s. Great job team :tada:

quota-bot: Override ov r_2026_179555 auto-expired as scheduled.

andy (eng-platform): Closing out — I will add this flow to the internal runbook under "temporary demo overrides" and include the curl snippet and checklist (ticket, TTL, audit reason, monitoring). Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
